reviews.text: My 9 month old kitten got spayed with them today and I have nothing but praise and just love for this clinic. I explained how I just started a new job and my pay wasn’t exactly stable yet and they waived her combo test for me and got her a sample of dewormer for free! They took such great care of my baby despite my panicking and she is recovering amazingly! They even sent her home with a little jingle bell ball that she was playing with there! Heading back in a few weeks for shots but I will always choose this clinic from now on for my cats the staff are so kind and professional! Thank you guys for taking care of my sweet Pumpkin girl!

The dedication and humility of the staff at Emancipet's Adams location in Philly are to be respected and studied. Five stars aren't enough to express the gratitude I have for the exceptional service and care provided to my pet. Jasmine and her team are absolutely awesome—thank you all so much for the incredible work you do!

Took my daughter’s two kittens here for their first vet visit and had a great experience. The staff was friendly, patient, and made us feel comfortable from the moment we walked in. They handled both kittens with care, answered all of my questions, and explained everything clearly. You can tell they genuinely care about the animals they treat. Definitely found a vet I feel comfortable bringing our kittens back to. Highly recommend! 🐱🐾❤️
Amazing service and the staff are phenomenal

It's still a bad place; it gets worse every year. Before, they gave appointments by phone, now you have to go in person, and I waited three hours just to get my cat's annual vaccinations. I had to wait three hours just to pay; it took over an hour. It's the worst place in Philadelphia and very expensive. They charge $20 for a consultation, and the doctor came in and didn't say anything. He couldn't even administer the vaccinations; he called someone else. What a terrible place! Besides, it smells awful and is very dirty. They don't clean the waiting room; it smells terrible.

Their automated system canceld my appointment that it had just offered, to which i said yes. spent an hour on hold waiting for a person to pick up.  just to be told their automated system had messed up and shouldnt have offered an appointment to begin with and shouldnt have canceled.
Exceptional customer service. Friendly staff. Clean and affordable.
Excellent service
The worst place 3 hours wait for a rabbies vaccine,they nasty people and the place stinks

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to the team of veterinarians who cared for my dog, Moana. We had to take her in for an emergency visit from one day to the next, and from the very first moment, they were incredibly kind, attentive, and loving. 🐶❤️
They made me feel calm and confident during a very worrying time for our family. Plus, the price was very reasonable, which I also greatly appreciate.

Thank you for taking care of Moana with so much love, patience, and professionalism. It's clear when they truly love what they do. I recommend them 100%! 🐾❤️
Friendly employees and I can say that your pet is in great hands

A good place to get your animals spayed and neutered and for a affordable price, what I don't like is I was told the nail clipping was free and when I went back to give my second cat neutered they charged me for the nail clipping without saying I have to pay for it they waited for me to pay and that's when I found out I paid for the nail clippings, I don't mind paying for it, but the thing is don't say it's free then charge me without me knowing on the next visit
Wonderful staff. The price was very reasonable.

Update: I decided to give Emancipet another chance with a different pet and I’m really glad I did. This visit was completely different from my first experience. The staff was kind, professional, informative, and treated both me and my pet very well. They explained everything clearly and made sure I understood his care and next steps. I truly appreciated how welcoming everyone was. My first experience wasn’t good but this second visit definitely changed my opinion for the better.
Love It Here, I Go For All My Pets. They Are Good & Affordable!

ALL OF THE STARS. Emancipet's staff truly love animals and it shows. My babygirl was well taken care of during her procedure ( spay). They thoroughly go over every step, recovery and future health of your pet, and they are the most affordable option I've found, with programs for low cost services.

Great !!! 10/10 ❤️ i did spay for my dog,great people working there include reception girls,They let me to stay with dog before they sleeped her.everything was clean. It’s already 10th day and stiches is closed well.I’m greatful and recommend.I trust them cause i see stuff was so friendly and lovely
They are always so friendly and helpful.

I'm impressed with how kind the staff were to us and our dog. She had to come in for emergency phone surgery aka spaying. The vet came out and talked to us and made sure we understood everything that was going on with her and the medication they were going to give her , antibiotics, pain meds, etc. they did a great job with her, she's home and recovering. They are a non profit please consider donating to them so they can continue to do this work . Surgery meds anesthesia fluids nail trim and microchipping etc all done for under $300' when another vet office quoted us over $5,000. We live about two hours away but to me it was well worth the drive and travel.

The service was great, and I had no complaints about it. However my pet pick up an odor from here. The odor was on my pet and inside my car for almost a week. It was truly awful! I had to wait about 4 days to wash my let because of the treatment they received my home also smelled unpleasant. Despite these issues, I still love this place. The staff is very professional, but the odor problem is what stresses me out the most.

I would recommend anyone to come here their team is amazing I’ve been coming here over 5 years for my cats and recently was given a dog that was found on the streets and they took care of my baby girl and got her all the shots she would need and even examined her. My baby left out a brand new dog and I know she feels much better they even clipped her nails. The team that saw my girl today are truly special and I’m glad that we have such a caring people to take care of our pets.
The best. 100% recommend.
Quick service, friendly staff and environment.

The whole staff was amazing!! They took great care of my baby, they were very comforting.
Not to mention very very affordable!! I'm never going anywhere else 👍🏾👍🏾 …
Kadira is beyond AMAZING! The entire staff was so awesome, THANKS EVERYONE!!!
Took my puppy here to get spayed and everything about this center was amazing. Extremely clean. Everyone was so caring and friendly.  Quick and efficient.
I love this place! The people are friendly and the prices are quite affordable. You can come and see for yourself why I highly recommend it.

This was a very positive experience, we took our female dog to get fixed and she was great. They provided us with medication to go home with and within 3 days she was running around slowly but her incision healed nice. Everyone was so nice, it does get very busy so patience will be needed. My dog was mad at me at first but she came around.
My boy cat got lots of attention and the staff were definitely helpful. Will definitely come back for his vet appointments.

Got my female kitten spayed today, and this place was great! Not only were they incredibly friendly but they treated my baby like a princess. I was having issues with money and I was $2 short, so they lady at the front desk took $2 out of her own bank account to help me. They saw that I was upset and instead of ignoring me the front desk lady gave me a hug and helped me. 100% couldn't recommend this place enough. If you're able to donate, this would be the place to do it. You know they will use your donations to help others
Walked in with new puppy. Got all her shots and rabies vaccine and flea heartworm tick prevention for $115. Not too bad. Friendly staff. Quick in and out under 1hr.

Amazing place with a great vibe! Everything is top-notch, but Alex at the front desk completely stole the show. Such an awesome, kind, and professional person. Thank you for the incredible service and care! ❤️

This is the only affordable place left in the Philadelphia Tri-State region. Every other spay and neuter Center is charging $200 to $300 for dogs over 50 lb... creating a vet bill of about $500 by the end. And today's economy that is not helpful or affordable. Thank you for making me having a pet affordable.
I really love the service. Molly it’s my baby cavapoo and since the first time that she goes she feels very happy . 10/10

I brought my puppy from Harrisburg who needed to get fixed and they did such a great job, you can barely see the incision. Besides the great care, the price I was quoted from a vet in Harrisburg was $1200 and today cost only $125! I was scared to death to have her go under anesthesia and I’m so happy I decided to take her here. They are wonderful.
Awesome experience every time I go love this organization thank you.
The service was excellent! So clean
The best clinic
very professional and speedy service. Need to be more clear on enforcing procedures but other than that not a bad experience.

Very disappointed with the experience at this veterinary office. We came because several friends and people we know recommended this place and told us they bring their pets here for general veterinary check-ups. However, when we arrived asking for a simple check-up for our dog, the receptionist with blonde hair wearing a red outfit was extremely rude and dismissive toward us.
She told us that “they don’t do that here,” which was confusing considering multiple people specifically recommended this clinic for regular veterinary care. It honestly felt like we were the only people being treated differently. On top of that, the receptionist told us we needed to leave because our dog “couldn’t be there,” even though we were simply trying to get veterinary attention for our pet.
We understand if a clinic has policies or limitations, but there is absolutely no reason to treat people with disrespect when they are only trying to care for their animal. Compassion and professionalism matter, especially in a veterinary office, and unfortunately we experienced neither here.

From the 1st phone call to schedule for.my male dog checkers to be fixed to the next day with the surgery. The staff was amazing. They kept.me.posted.and showed care and concern. I will.continue to bring my pets here.I appreciate all the staff for taking care of my.baby

I would give Emancipet a 10/10.

This is not the first or even second time I’ve been here—I’ve been coming for years. My first visit was about 2–4 years ago when I brought my female dog in to get spayed, and everything went smoothly with no issues at all. That experience is actually what made me come back again for my other pets.

Since then, I’ve brought my male dog and my female cats in to be fixed as well. I have a total of six pets—four dogs and two kittens—and I’ve also brought them all here for their vaccinations. Every single visit has been a great experience. I’ve never had any issues with their shots or surgeries, and everything has always gone well.

The staff is always very friendly, helpful, and professional, which makes the whole process easy and stress-free. I usually bring all of my pets at once when they need their vaccines, and they’re always accommodating and patient with me, which I really appreciate.

Another big reason I recommend them is the affordability. Having multiple pets can get expensive, but their prices are very reasonable and have helped me save a lot of money over time.

Overall, I definitely recommend Emancipet because of their consistent care, great staff, and affordable services.
Very good

I recently sought spaying services for my new puppy and found a significant cost difference between my regular veterinarian, who quoted $972, and Emancipet, where the procedure, including a cone, three prescriptions, and two months of flea and tick prevention, totaled $200. Furthermore, I was impressed by the consistently friendly demeanor of the staff at Emancipet.

Very happy with their service. The staff is wonderful.
Thanks everyone

Emancipet the GOAT. Affordable care to keep ya pets healthy and happy. Updating all of our two dogs vaccinations costs us less than 400. Other vets were telling us it would be 900 to do both of em. Yall are a godsend frfr. The vets that work at low cost clinics are some of the nicest vets ive encountered.

After a poor experience with a local veterinarian group, I took our puppy to the Adams rd location. They were so kind, & understanding. The vet tech (“the big guy”) was super. He made a very purposeful effort to help my puppy feel safe. They met our puppy’s needs. Absolutely Fantastic!!!

I took my dog here for his yearly vaccines, and his flea/tick/heartworm pills that he takes monthly.
The vet and staff were wonderful to Ben, and the prices are much cheaper than the vet that I used to go to.  I'm so glad that I found Emancipet -- they are a wonderful organization 😊.  Five claws up from Ben 🐾🐶🐾

Came to get shots for my dog,  & added nail trim . I honestly think that the licensed vet only should be doing nail trims . I have a very small dog and the young lady trimming cut two of her wicks back to back which my dog of course bled  . After the first snip I would think to be more cautious like to look where her wick is  , I could have did the trim at home my self if it was a chance she would bleed . I would not recommend a nail trim here . Other than that, satisfied w the shots

I can NoT thank emancipet enough for saving my pug Maybel. We found out at another pet hospital Saturday February 28th she had pyometra. Unfortunately they required 8,000 dollars to do this life saving surgery. We do not have that kind of money. My husband and I were going to make a very difficult decision to put her down that night.  She was just in too much pain for weeks. We decided to wait, let’s first do some research before making that terrible decision. We found & called emancipet that night from the hospital. Nicole answered! We couldn’t believe it on a Saturday after 5???!! She Told us she wasn’t sure if they could get her in Monday or Tuesday… I wound up emailing Sunday night telling them …I did not think she was going to make it until Tuesday ,asking them to please consider taking her Monday because I was afraid she would not make it another day. Emancipet called my husband at 8:03 Monday morning, saying they would have an answer eitherway for us in about an hour- At 9:45 Monday morning, they called us and told us to get her there before 12 o’clock and that they would get her in for the surgery! I couldn’t believe it. I got there at 10:30am there were only two people ahead of us. As soon as I gave them her name , They knew why we were there and somebody came and took her right back. They were kind, caring and the gentleman that took my info at the front desk was absolutely wonderful. The vets & techs were amazing and made sure to give the take home meds with instructions on “how to”. She is now home and recovering. The vet even called today just to check up on her. Myself my husband and my three boys cannot thank you enough for giving us more time with our Maybel ! I work at a hair salon and have already told MANY clients about my experience with emancipet. I’m pretty sure one already donated tonight after hearing our story- We are so so so grateful to everyone at emancipet and will continue to tell any and everyone that will listen about how wonderful this place is💕
Thank you!
The customer service is always friendly and helpful. The wait times can be long most times even after making an appointment. However, their prices are very affordable.
I love it, couldn't believe how cheap vaccines and services were. I bring all 3 of my dogs there now.
Affordable Pet Services  !!!! Great Staff !!!!

I usually go to the Roosevelt Blvd clinic but this was just as exceptional aside from the quality of surrounding area. Technicians were top notch with communication and timeliness of services. I would really like to mention Luis from the call center for this industry for handling a very urgent situation I had. He went above and beyond to ensure myself and my pets were taken care of during a very stressful situation. Every workplace deserves employees like Luis, he was one of a kind.

I went on Tuesday Jan 6 to get my cat neutered/spayed. They offered additional services that included trimming the nails. My cat comes back to me what seemed to be fine but is limping on one of his back paws. One of his toenails is completely gone leaving a hole and swollen leg. I do not recommend any other extra services from them other than what you go there for. I will be filing some sort of complaint because my cat is in pain for an uncalled for removal of his nail when all that was asked for was a trim. However the procedure was fine.
Very professional,clean & friendly they were always cleaning so place looked bright and open and inviting. There was about a 30min wait even with an appointment.
Dont line up at the door in the morning. There's signs that say not to but once people line up you can't see it. So just give yourself a bit of extra time. Friendly staff.
Great. And my kittens healed up very fast and well.
The best . They are so patience with my Gemstone.  Because he is a handful.
Kind staff! We had a good experience
We need an emancipet in south jersey near Sicklerville area or even in Clementon
Polite and professional.

Great service! Affordable pet care. Very grateful!
First time there, they were great! They were really good with 2 year old female pitbull! Really good for shots, microchips  and quick check up's. We were in and out quickly. Thank you

Today I took my cat, Louis Vuitton, to get vaccinated and neutered. The staff was super friendly and caring!
My English isn’t very strong yet, since Portuguese is my first language, but they were incredibly patient, kind, and enthusiastic. They respected my pace and made me feel very comfortable. I’m really happy with the service and the care they gave to my Louis Vuitton!

My second visit for my cat, Cairo. The staff, veterinarian are professional, caring and pleasant.
The service is great as was as the “in-out” timing.
The veterinarian asks thoughtful questions and ask/ suggest what vaccines, etc. are recommended for Cairo’s next visit.

Took my pup there to get neutered last September, late to review but everything worked out great. Quick check-in in the morning, he was ready to go home by 4pm. Staff was so friendly, talked about how sweet my dog was under their care and gave clear instructions when I was taking him home. They do spay/neuters all day every day in there, there is no better expert. Bruno recovered perfectly and is healthy as can be. The absolute most Affordable and safe option for my dude.

When I say I'm taking my hearts to them when I take my pups there and they treat them as there own. Love this about them. I'm not even from the area and I drive almost an hour for them to take care of my babies

The vet and the vet tech were amazing, knowledgeable, and professional but the girl at the check-in desk was very off putting and unprofessional. I get there a little before 4 o'clock and right away she tries to get me to leave by telling me that the wait time would be 3 and a half hours which made no sense because they closed in 2 hours. She also tried to get me to go to another location 20 minutes away but again that made no sense because this location is in my neighborhood so after telling her that I don't mind waiting and seeing the angry look on her face it was just very uncomfortable for me.

They basically have you either wait in your car or go home and then they will text you when they are ready for you, so me thinking that I'm going to have to wait hours, I go home, but as soon as I pull in my driveway, I get the text that they are ready for me, so I head back. When I check in at the desk, the same girl basically tells me that she accidentally told me to come back, but I honestly feel like she did this on purpose. The whole thing and just dealing with her was very uncomfortable, because she kept using this fake nice little girl voice while saying and doing mean things to me.

Aside from her off putting vibes and treatment, I really did enjoy everything else. I like that they use a texting system so that you can go about your business and they will text you when they're ready, and the vet and the vet tech that worked with my cat were very nice and professional, considering that my cat is very unpredictable and skittish, and they worked with her very well.

Oh, and by the way, I was done and out of there in one and a half hours from the moment that I checked in.
Well priced and good service. My dog had a vaccine reaction and they treated that for free.

My dog got neutered here & he gets his annual vaccines here. They’re great! They can get busy but they have a system that is orderly and gets you in and out of there quickly! They are also affordable. I recommend them!

We were escorted to a closed room to wait to eleviate the stress she was going through since she was just starting to be in heat again. It was a Hail Mary that she was never accidentally made pregnant. The staff were so Professional. Once she was sedated she was checked to ensure she was sleep. Once she was placed in the  stretcher she was  taken to the back. We went up
The street to a Wendy’s to wait for her. By the time we sat down we a message in our phones saying she was recovering we ci
could pick her up at 12:00pm. She came out bumping into things with a cone on her head

Long story short, come join the queue then leave and come back later.

Today, August 4th, at 5:09 PM, we arrived at the veterinary clinic, which is officially listed as being open until 6:00 PM. However, we were told that they already shut down and that we couldn’t come in — even though there were still nearly 50 minutes left until closing time.

We were very disappointed.
If the clinic closes earlier than posted, or if access becomes restricted before 6:00 PM, clients should be informed in advance — either on the website, over the phone, or through your Google business listing.

We made the effort to arrive well before closing, expecting to receive service, and instead wasted our time. This feels unprofessional and disrespectful toward customers.

We hope the clinic will reconsider how it manages closing procedures and ensures that access is available during all stated business hours.

the staff was super nice and helpful i would go back if i get another dog thank u guys for all and keep up the great work 10/10

I recently was the recipient of a rehomed pet. And I had to get in touch with amancipet to get the dogs files and medication records.  And I had the pleasure in speaking with Carla. I cannot tell you what a breath of fresh air speaking to her was from the minute She picked the phone up. She was extremely helpful and happy. Glad to help and wanted to help. However, the wait times here are incredibly long and poorly managed. On my visit, I was told there would be a five-hour wait, yet they continued to check in new customers throughout the day. I had a terrible experience at this vet clinic and regret trusting them with my dog’s surgery. I paid $586 for my Frenchie’s cherry eye procedure, and from the start, I was only told it had a 50/50 success rate—but no real discussion about alternative options. After just a day and a half, one of the cherry eyes popped back out. When I returned, the vet casually said, “Well, at least you got one,” which was completely unprofessional. That same night, the other eye popped out too. When I went back again, they referred me to a specialist—something they should have done from the very beginning, especially since my dog’s breed is prone to relapse. I only found this out after doing my own research, but I initially trusted their judgment because they seemed knowledgeable. That was my mistake.

It’s not about the money—it’s about the fact that my dog has been suffering unnecessarily and will likely have to go through another procedure. On top of that, the stitches they did were poorly done—one is hanging out, and his eye looks even worse than before. To make things worse, they told me to clean his eye with hydrogen peroxide water, which I later found out can be extremely harmful and even cause blindness. I can’t believe a professional would give such careless advice.

If you have a Frenchie with cherry eye, do NOT bring them here for surgery. You’ll waste your money and time, and your dog will most likely suffer. I wish I had known better before coming here.
